title: Felix and the Extraction
author: Vesper Yarrow
blurb: Cyrus Crane, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
